__fixture__.scenario: A partner-confidential corpus that cannot enter CI is admitted synthetic-only with a cleared license, both reviews, a legal clearance, a time-boxed retention, and an available synthetic fallback.

license.note: Partner-provided traces licensed for benchmark methodology under a confidentiality agreement.

redaction.method: Partner content cannot be de-identified to repository safety; a synthetic substitute reproduces the workload shape.

retention.note: Held in the partner enclave and purged on schedule; only the synthetic fallback enters CI.

synthetic_fallback.fidelity_note: Reproduces the partner workload's edit-burst and undo cadence within the calibrated tolerance.

intake_decision.decision_note: Approved for synthetic-only protected-CI use; the real partner traces stay out of the repository.
